description: Find what a company's filings say about a keyword. Searches the 10-K/10-Q narrative, the 8-K events digest and the financial record's sourcing notes, and returns the paragraphs and list items that contain every word of the query, best first, each in full with its section and subsection, plus a ranked list of the sections that mention it most (to read one whole with get_narrative or get_events). Case-insensitive; double quotes match an exact phrase. Examples: 'buyback authorization', '"remaining performance obligations"', 'China export', 'credit facility', 'goodwill impairment', 'CEO'.

documents.description: Which documents to search: narrative (10-K/10-Q synthesis), events (8-K digest), notes (the financial record's sourcing notes and uncertainties). Default all three.

record.description: An earlier published record, by tag ('FY27Q1') or by the period its filing reports ('Q1 FY2027'). Omit for the latest. list_periods lists every record.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, case-insensitive. Examples: NVDA, brk-b, BRK.B.

name: search_text
title: Keyword search across the filings synthesis
